title: GEISA Application Message Request v0.9.0
description: Canonical structure for GEISA application messaging request payloads aligned to app-message.proto. The payload bytes are opaque application data selected by content-type and carried as base64 in JSON examples.

geisa-app-message-req.$comment: Application and application-instance identity come from authenticated GEISA topic/session binding and are not duplicated in app-message request payloads. Quota counters/usage values are not carried here; those are reported through Platform/App Status.

request-id.description: Application request identifier used for correlation.

priority.description: ADM object 3600-style message priority for app-facing messaging.

message-type.description: App-message type aligned to ADM object 3600 Message Type.

timestamp-ms.description: UTC epoch time in milliseconds when the message was created.

ttl-seconds.description: Message TTL in seconds; 0 means no explicit message-specific TTL and allows platform/EMS default policy.

content-type.description: MIME type describing the opaque payload bytes.

payload-base64.description: Base64-encoded opaque payload bytes. GEISA app-message requests carry a non-empty application payload.
